guard: Initial bootstrap material and five reserved local keys publish together; only the protected synced winner returns
why: The rebuilt public package runs against real private files. Two owned Node processes pause before native publication, then converge on the same persisted candidate. Labelled directory-rename, sync, expiry and process-exit interleavings exercise the actual claim. The pre-read check is independent of the parser so a later refusal cannot hide an unsafe read. This is not power-loss, file-take, host cleanup, activated recovery, admission or hosted proof. Every mutant builds manager and every afterRestore rebuilds restored manager.
